name: Paguroideo
source:
Paguroideo is a visual novel that uses elements like surrealism and dissociation to explore themes of alienation, identity, and aquariums.

[Edited from [url=https://areqreepy.itch.io/paguroideo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Paguroideo》是一部运用超现实主义与解离感等表现手法，探讨疏离、身份认同与水族馆主题的视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://areqreepy.itch.io/paguroideo]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
